architecture: Vertical BT30 milling spindle over a table-side trunnion: published as tilt axis A (-30 to +120 deg, roller gear cam, backlashless, clampless) carrying a C turning spindle (built-in direct-drive motor; used as indexing table, turning spindle and cutting-feed rotary). The trunnion has a 'table side' (C spindle) and a 'tail side' support (separate load ratings). Turning is done with stationary turning tools held in the milling spindle (double plunger lock). Brother publishes this tilt as A (by ISO convention, about X); the brief's 'B tilt' is NOT what Brother publishes. Which unit carries X/Y/Z is not stated on the fetched page.

control.standard: Brother CNC-C00 (12.1in LCD), 5 axes X,Y,Z,A,C; linear interp 4 axes

C.indexing_or_full: full; turning spindle max 2,000 rpm, 3.6 kW motor, 55 N·m / 8.7 kW max

spindle_nose_type: Table top per ISO 702-4 nose No.5 (JIS B6109-2)

coolant.notes: CTS optional (cyclone filter tank special option on M-X3)

options: BV7-870 loading system (weight 3,050 kg with it)
notes: Sibling M300X3 on same page: X300, table D170, 75 kg, turning 1,500 rpm 102 N·m 9.9 kW, A index 50 rpm, weight 2,880 kg. M200X3: table-side 40 kg / 0.29 kg·m², tail-side 11 kg / 0.04 kg·m². Tool-to-tool 0.8 s in spec table but 0.9 s in the overview text (table value recorded). Max jig size dia 300 x H300 mm reported in a search snippet only (not verified on fetched page). Page lists M-X3 as 'Discontinued'; current successors M200Xd1/M300Xd1/M300Xd2. Overall W x D = required floor space. Cutting feed 30 m/min only in high accuracy mode B.
